purpose: Reviewed OWASP ZAP Access Control assessment for the authorized local VAmPI teaching lab. The runner permits only the declared GET fixtures.
execution_requirements: Use a dedicated fresh ZAP session bound only to 127.0.0.1:8080; authenticated bootstrap messages may remain in Core history.
Import a manually reviewed local Context that contains exactly three enabled users: admin, userA, and userB.
The local Context and any authentication material are private mode-0600 files and must not be committed or copied into results.
The Context include regexes must match only these five absolute GET paths; Access Rules must be reviewed in ZAP Desktop before export.
Validate the Context against a non-secret fingerprint attestation before the scan.

After verified user authentication and before baseline capture, require two equal target-scoped Core message counts one second apart; retry for at most ten seconds and stop NOT_RUN before seed or scan on timeout.
Use only the Access Control add-on; do not spider, AJAX-spider, active-scan, fuzz, enumerate, or import the full OpenAPI specification.
Do not export Authorization headers, bearer tokens, credentials, request/response bodies, raw API errors, or raw ZAP HTML.

containment_policy.authoritative_evidence: Actual target HTTP messages returned by the paginated ZAP history API.
containment_policy.permitted_message: GET to exactly http://127.0.0.1:5000 plus one listed path, with no query or fragment.
containment_policy.site_tree: Bare origin and path-parent nodes are structural diagnostics only. They neither authorize nor block a scan.
containment_policy.post_auth_quiescence: Before the private baseline, two target-scoped Core message counts must be equal one second apart. Changed counts retry for at most ten seconds; timeout stops NOT_RUN before seed or scan.
containment_policy.post_auth_baseline: Authentication and verification-poll traffic is captured only as an in-memory Core-history identity baseline after quiescence. It is never exported and is not assessment traffic.
containment_policy.assessment_delta: The seed delta must contain exactly one approved GET per declared path; every scan delta message must be an approved GET to a declared path.
block_conditions: Any malformed request line or unavailable paginated history page.
Post-auth target-history quiescence timeout or invalid target-scoped Core message count.
Any non-GET method, query, fragment, foreign scheme/host/port, unapproved path, or /createdb request.
Any unverified Context, user, authentication state, or reviewed rule attestation.
